## Core

- [Decisions](.memoc/03-decisions.md): durable decisions.
- [Log](.memoc/log.md): append-only history.
- [Systems](.memoc/systems/README.md): subsystem docs.
- [Wiki](.memoc/wiki/index.md): synthesized knowledge.
